Good questions

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-10-25T16:01:56+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2114386990988968379; média: nincs média]
How come Elon Musk is the only one seriously talking about all these young people dying in the trenches for no reason and begging for this war to stop? Innocent young Ukrainians and Russian conscripts are getting blown apart by drones, losing their lives

And then you look at Europe. What do you only keep hearing from so many European leaders? More weapons, more ammunition, more military support. “We cannot let Russia win”

You almost never hear them seriously talking about how to bring peace and end this war for good

Why the hell aren't those same leaders putting that much energy into figuring out how to stop this meat grinder?

What are these leaders actually doing to stop young people from dying every single day? What are they doing to end this endless slaughter? Why aren't they putting the same urgency into finding a way to end this war instead of constantly talking about sending more weapons and how they should continue this war forever?

These are human beings. They have parents, families, loved ones, and entire lives ahead of them. And they're dying in trenches because of decisions made by people who will never have to experience what those young soldiers are going through

And that includes the poor Russian conscripts who have no choice but to fight. They're human beings too. Their lives matter too

How many more young people need to die before stopping this war becomes just as important as deciding who wins it?

Why does it take Elon Musk to keep reminding people about the human lives being destroyed by this war?

Seriously, where the hell is the urgency to stop all this killing? everyone who wants to continue this war is pure evil
